definitions.explanation: An acronym for lesbian, gay, bisexual, and transgender, used to refer to sexual orientation and gender identity minorities.

examples.japanese: LGBT⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{権利|けんり}→権利：02711_kenri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
LGBT⟦{当事者|とうじしゃ}→当事者：12504_toujisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聴|き}く→聴く：30010_kiku⟧。
examples.english: We listen to the voices of LGBT individuals.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧LGBTフレンドリーな⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧づくり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}めている→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: This company is promoting an LGBT-friendly workplace.

notes:
LGBT stands for Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, and Transgender.
